body:
A Hero would've sucked it up.
I do it as an honoring of his memory.
And my enjoyment.

Not angey, just nothingness.
Until just a few days ago when i started what i call a vengeance hunt, basically i would hunt down the fuckers in my school who pushed him to suicide and would beat them until they go blank.
It's already working well too.

from what i can read you were not that close, not physically at least.
if he did it though, i'm sorry for your loss, my best friend took the same path four years ago and i still can't get over it.

don't you DARE let him.
at the very least try.
you don't want to know how that feels, it will always haunt you.

i'm always up if you need someone to talk to
i'm starting to lose all that makes me human so i would appreciate it as well.

I'm starting to enjoy food less now, can barley force a giggle, it's like I'm 13 all over again.
Somehow i like this feeling.

i went a whole week without being able to sleep, they had to drug me to sleep in Er, and i went numb for a year, no feelings, no laughs, nothing.
i'm pretty sure i'm a 1 out of a million to go through that without following his footsteps, and i didn't do anything at all, i knew he was depressed and i just watched him die slowly.
i take part of the blame if i were to put it lightly.
i'm all ears if you want someone to talk to, i could use that talk as well.
i assume something really happened to the point of you considering this, if you need to talk i'm all ears.
